fields.name: pre_press_target
fields.description: Despite its legacy name, store the [y, x] execution-start center of the physical target selected by the instruction. For 'right before' the demonstration button press, select the named cube's last completed target placement before that press. For 'right after', select its first completed target placement after that press, not its unchanged resting position immediately after button contact. Identify completed placements from release and subsequent resting evidence. Follow the selected physical target through the remaining demonstration, including target movements and exchanges, and use its center in the execution-start scene. Do not substitute another target that later occupies its earlier location. Write this at decision step #1 and retain it unchanged thereafter. If the selected target cannot be identified, write "unknown". e.g. [126, 145]
